name: application-mention-textarea
title: Mention Textarea
description: Composer textarea with @-mention autocomplete — typing "@" opens a filtered popover of real users below the field, and picking one inserts the mention token at the trigger position.
useWhen: Writing a comment, note, or message where the author needs to tag a specific person from a known user list.
You want typed "@" to trigger a real filtered popover rather than requiring users to pick from a static picker.
The composed text is plain text with mention tokens, not rich formatted content.
avoidWhen: You need free-text tags with no predefined suggestion list — use Tag Input or a plain textarea instead.
The composer needs rich formatting (bold, links, embeds) — this component only handles plain text plus mention tokens.
The list of mentionable users is very large and needs server-side search — extend the filter logic before shipping.
responsiveBehavior: The mention popover is anchored below the textarea at a fixed width; on narrow viewports ensure the containing layout leaves room for it to render without being clipped.
accessibility: The mention popover is a role='listbox' with role='option' items, matching combobox conventions.
Escape closes the mention popover without submitting or clearing the textarea's existing content.
Options use onMouseDown preventDefault so clicking a suggestion inserts the mention before the textarea blurs.

variants.title: Mention textarea
variants.description: Textarea with an in-progress "@m" mention showing a filtered single-match popover, on a light surface.
accessibility: The Post button remains reachable by keyboard even while the mention popover is open.

variants.title: Mention textarea (Dark)
variants.description: Textarea with an in-progress mention popover, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Popover and textarea border colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
